gaps: Lab page (dorresteinlab.ucsd.edu/publications) is stale — its 'Selected publications' list stops at 2020, so no value beyond pointers to Scholar/PubMed. PubMed 2024-2026 yielded the authoritative 118-paper backbone (fully captured here in 100+18 form). Google Scholar added ~12 items missing from PubMed: several abstracts (Alzheimer's & Dementia AAIC, DDW Gastroenterology, ChemRxiv MSnLib/MetaboApps, J Immunol), two US patents, a Cell paper (Schmitz et al., mitophagy-pluripotency) for which I could not pull a DOI, the Zong et al. Gastroenterology BSH paper (DOI not exposed by Scholar), and the Charron-Lamoureux 'drug-activating microbial BA conjugation' preprint (DOI not retrieved — likely on bioRxiv with the 10.64898 prefix used for newer 2026 entries). I did NOT fully verify bioRxiv/ChemRxiv beyond what surfaced through PubMed+Scholar — there may be 2026 preprints not yet indexed. The 'Latham et al.' and 'González et al.' Osteoarthritis and Cartilage entries appear to be SECTRA/OARSI abstracts and I could not confirm full author lists. The Murillo-Saich OA paper (PMID 41763351) appears to subsume the synovitis-OA work. Preprints and their published versions are listed separately when both surfaced — the user can collapse pairs. Counts in stats are approximate because preprint↔journal pairs would otherwise be double-counted; I left both versions in the catalog to make the audit easier.
